Michigan Senate Race Sees Democratic Congresswoman Endorse Republican

U.S. Representative Haley Stevens, a Democrat, has endorsed Republican Mike Rogers in the Michigan Senate race, a move that has caused divisions within the Democratic party. Stevens' endorsement came after a dispute with her Democratic rival, Abdul El-Sayed. Senate Majority Leader Chuck Schumer called Stevens' endorsement "a despicable betrayal." Representative Debbie Dingell stated that Stevens "seriously hurt herself" with the decision. Senator Bernie Sanders commented that GOP rhetoric regarding El-Sayed "should appall every decent American." The endorsement has been described as a "new twist" in the critical Michigan Senate race, with some suggesting it spells trouble for Democrats in 2028.
